purpose: Anonymized seed and test data for the PLTS clay model. Structural patterns drawn from real intake traffic; all customers, parts, prices, and people are invented. Raw source data is not stored in this repo (see CLAUDE.md guardrail).

examples.title: Lease flavor for a limited-status product
examples.route_reason: Base product on limited/discontinued status; exception policy requires review
examples.trigger: Partner evaluation likely to convert to a lease
failure_modes: two conflicting derived prices in one thread
examples.clay_model_assertion: Limited-status create must raise an exception flag and route to review; derived price is one computed field

examples.title: Monthly flavor of an existing annual part
examples.route_reason: Clone of an existing part with one attribute change (billing frequency)
examples.trigger: Live order needs a monthly option alongside the annual part
examples.clay_model_assertion: Clone references parent part and routes straight to the Operations queue

examples.title: Third-party add-on wrongly swept into annual increase
examples.route_reason: Error correction, revert to previously agreed values
examples.trigger: Royalty product caught by the annual increase despite a separate negotiated change
failure_modes: no third-party exclusion flag on the increase run
examples.clay_model_assertion: Parts carry a third-party/royalty flag; correction type records the causing run

examples.title: New offering structure (editions and bundling)
examples.route_reason: New editions, bundling, and license-model decisions
examples.trigger: Go-to-market decision: drop one edition, bundle an add-on into the initial purchase
failure_modes: decision email stuck in an outbox for a week
no shared home for decision + pricebook + advisory
no visibility the process was blocked
examples.clay_model_assertion: Triggers relevance questions and a visible status so a stalled step is seen

examples.title: Urgent hosting-fee part blocking a renewal invoice
examples.route_reason: Straightforward new fee part; urgent because a live invoice is blocked
examples.trigger: Renewal invoice blocked: quote line uses a SaaS license part, matching hosting part does not exist
failure_modes: material attribute settled by a one-word email
examples.clay_model_assertion: Urgent flag requires naming the blocked downstream artifact

cross_cutting.no_single_front_door: Multiple intake aliases plus direct personal email; cases only threaded mail, no routing/fields/status/queue
cross_cutting.approver_concentration: Every thread resolved on one person replying by email
cross_cutting.deal_driven_share: 4 of 5 requests originated inside a live quote, order, or renewal
